name: Kasumigaseki
tagline: Toranomon in 1 minute and Tokyo in 5 minutes. Served by 3 lines.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, where Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 5 minutes to Otemachi, 13 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 20 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 7.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 7.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.4 m to 20.7 m, a difference of 16.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 18 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 浩邦会日比谷病院, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 虎の門病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line are available too. All 3 lines are run by Tokyo Metro, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line runs at 163% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 三ノ輪→入谷, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154%. Its busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150%. Its busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Sakuradamon; for rail connections, Kasumigaseki.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kasumigaseki. Sakuradamon has only the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line, so Kasumigaseki is the better connected. To Toranomon, for instance, Sakuradamon takes 9 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Sakuradamon comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how easy the shopping is, Kokkai-Gijidomae; for rail connections, Kasumigaseki.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kasumigaseki. Kokkai-Gijidomae has only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line and Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line, so Kasumigaseki is the better connected. To Toranomon, for instance, Kokkai-Gijidomae takes 7 minutes longer. On how easy the shopping is, though, Kokkai-Gijidomae comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
noiseSources: The 首都高速都心環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
桜田通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: OpenStreetMap records no supermarket within walking distance of the station.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are some of the most heavily loaded in the morning.
